name: Peb Fort (Vikatgad)
tagline: A quiet fort trek from Neral — Matheran's less-crowded neighbor
seoTitle: Peb Fort (Vikatgad) Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Peb Fort near Neral and Matheran — a quieter alternative fort trek, season, safety, and packing.

routeOptions.name: From Neral
routeOptions.notes: Reached easily by train to Neral — good option if traveling from Mumbai without a car.

safety.intro: Peb Fort is quieter than nearby Matheran and Prabalgad, which means less foot traffic to rely on if something goes wrong.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Less crowded than neighboring treks — tell someone your plan
Combine with a Matheran day trip if you want a fuller day out

cards.title: On the trail
items: Forest sections can be overgrown post-monsoon — watch the path markers
Some rocky scrambling near the fort itself

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Quieter trail than most on this list — extra caution warranted going alone
Easily reached by train from Mumbai, useful if you don't have your own vehicle

items.name: Offline map of the route — less signage than popular forts

gettingThere.intro: Reached by train to Neral, then a walk along the narrow-gauge Matheran railway track.

steps.title: Reach Neral
steps.body: Karjat/Khopoli-line local train from Mumbai CSMT/Dadar/Thane/Kalyan to Neral station (roughly 1.5–2 hrs from CSMT). Neral is the access point, not Matheran itself.

steps.title: Shared taxi to the trailhead
steps.body: Outside Neral station, shared taxis running toward Matheran will drop you at the '134 NM' railway marker on request — mention 'Peb trek' or 'Kadyavarcha Ganpati'. Roughly a 15–20 minute ride.

steps.title: Walk the tracks to the diversion
steps.body: From 134 NM, walk along the Neral–Matheran narrow-gauge railway track for about 40 minutes to the 155 NM marker, where the trail diverges from the tracks.

steps.title: Ascend to the fort
steps.body: From the diversion it's roughly 2.5–3 hrs to the summit through forest and rock patches.

steps.title: Return
steps.body: Retrace to 134 NM for a shared taxi back to Neral, then a local train. Services run fairly late, but confirm the timetable at Neral station rather than assuming — they thin out after peak hours.

gettingThere.permitNote: No entry fee or forest permit — this is an open, unregulated hill climb. Carry your own water; there's nothing reliable on the trail itself.

onTrail.note: Not compulsory — the path is well-trodden; optional for first-timers
Carry your own; stalls only near the Matheran side
